title: C++: Factory Pattern
description: Implement the Factory pattern to create different types of vehicles.

steps.title: Vehicle Factory
steps.description: Define an abstract Vehicle class with virtual void drive(). Implement Car and Motorcycle. Create a VehicleFactory with static Vehicle* create(string type). Use factory to create a Car and Motorcycle and call drive() on each.
hints: Vehicle* create(const string& type) { if (type == "car") return new Car(); else if (type == "motorcycle") return new Motorcycle(); return nullptr; }

verification.test: output.includes('Driving a car') && output.includes('Riding a motorcycle')
